source_document: User supplied Research design paper Version 3, Pasted text.txt
scope_note: The pasted V3 text names technologies and primary-documentation titles but contains no literal GitHub repository URLs. These are verified canonical upstream mappings plus clearly labeled supplemental engineering tools and user baseline developer repositories. The observed SHAs document this review, not dependency locks or evidence of compatibility.

entries.name: PaperMC/Paper
entries.license: GPL-3.0 with identified MIT contributions; mixed per LICENSE.md
entries.use_mode: Use a pinned Paper server artifact and compile-only plugin API; implement AgentCity plugin separately. Do not fork the server.
entries.limitations: Latest main advertises 26.3 and Java 25; bot README advertises through 26.1. Verify a compatible intersection and runtime. Paper license is inherited GPL-3.0 with identified MIT contributions; inspect artifact/file terms.

entries.name: PrismarineJS/mineflayer-pathfinder

entries.name: Redstone-Compiler/redstone-compiler
entries.license: MIT; copyright rollrat 2024-2026; notice retained with candidate data
entries.role: Unvalidated two-bit adder source data candidate

entries.name: henkelmax/simple-voice-chat
entries.license: Copyright (c) Max Henkel - All Rights Reserved; upstream binaries downloaded only for local use, not redistributed
entries.role: Private in-game push-to-talk capture and owner-targeted audio playback
entries.use_mode: Pinned Bukkit and Fabric 2.6.27 artifacts with hashes in config/voice-dependencies.json; compile-only API 2.6.27. Separate EthCraft voice bridge and opaque loopback UDP transport.
entries.limitations: Local offline-mode server only. Requires matching Fabric client, microphone permission, explicit PTT key binding and actual human acceptance. No upstream binaries or implementation sources copied into the published checkout.
entries.revision_status: Observed source for controls/license; runtime artifacts pinned separately by cryptographic digest

important_findings: 0G canonical org/package changed. Use 0gfoundation/0g-compute-ts-sdk and current package name; V3 Router-first must not accidentally inherit Direct funding/accounting.
Paper latest main and Mineflayer advertised latest support differ. Pin a tested common game/server/bot/Java/Node matrix.
Uniswap v2 constant-product and v3 papers are explanatory research references. They are not additional AMM implementations to deploy for this v4 project.
No requirement in V3 names Voyager, MineDojo, LangChain, LangGraph or other autonomous-agent frameworks. Do not add them based on popularity.
0G starter license remains unverified. Study only until copy/use terms are established; hosted Router HTTP integration does not require copying that starter.
Arkiv SDK extends viem; install its peer rather than building our own chain RPC/signing stack.
Private AgentCity repository does not erase upstream BUSL/GPL/MIT/ISC/Apache obligations. Do not add a blanket permissive project license over copied upstream code.
Headroom, RTK, Caveman and Ponytail remain development tools; installing them in the game runtime would add irrelevant dependencies.
Use a known tested v4 core/periphery/router/template combination and verify actual deployment identities; latest default-branch SHAs are observations only.
revision_verification: For every entry, verified_revision was read from the authenticated GitHub REST repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{default_branch} endpoint, not inferred from a URL or fabricated. Every recorded sha is a 40-character hexadecimal string. This verifies the observed commit identity, not compatibility, release quality or a dependency lock.
